output.patientMessage: Call 911 now, or have someone take you to the nearest emergency department immediately — do not drive yourself. A sudden 'worst ever' headache with new neck stiffness needs urgent emergency brain imaging today to rule out bleeding around the brain. If you develop drowsiness, confusion, vomiting, seizure, fainting, or weakness or speech trouble while waiting, call 911 right away.
